readerCopy.body: The past can feel soft enough around the edges that you forget why you left it. Neptune trine the South Node can make old dreams, memories, relationships, and creative identities feel unusually tender and easy to revisit. There may be something worth reclaiming in the feeling or imagination. Keep the part that still feeds you. Do not let a beautiful memory erase the practical reasons the chapter ended.
